appearance.clothing: navy work jacket over a checked shirt, warehouse ID on a lanyard
appearance.shoes: steel-toe work boots, mud dried on the soles

characters.name: Martin Holloway
characters.protects: His role in covering up the Pier 9 accident that killed a young loader.

records.summary: Two formal complaints from load workers about unsafe conditions at Pier 9, both dismissed after Martin's rebuttal.
Martin was a named respondent in the insurer's probe of the 2022 fatal accident; he was cleared based on the report he wrote himself.
Owns 3 Harlow Lane jointly with his ex-wife; the deed transfer after divorce is still incomplete.
Owes roughly £4,200 on a store card, mostly behind on minimum payments.

characters.secret: He falsified the safety report on a fatal warehouse accident two years ago and kept the original incident form hidden at home.

appearance.clothing: grey cardigan over clinic scrubs, hair pinned back

characters.name: Elena Vasquez
characters.protects: Her access to the fentanyl stocks and a stock ledger discrepancy she never reported.

records.summary: Elena filed a formal complaint in 2023 accusing Martin Holloway of falsifying the accident report that killed her brother Tomas; it was rejected for lack of evidence.
Tomas Vasquez, her brother, is listed in public inquest papers as the deceased in the 2022 Pier 9 accident that Martin's report attributed to worker error.
Signed out of St. Clare Clinic ten minutes early on the morning of the murder, citing a dental appointment that the practice has no record of.

characters.relationshipToVictim: sister of the loader who died in Martin's warehouse accident
characters.secret: She requested a transfer to the pharmacy store room three months ago, which gave her unsupervised access to controlled stock.

appearance.clothing: hi-vis vest over a hooded sweatshirt
appearance.shoes: heavy work boots with oil-stained toes

characters.fakeMotive: Blames Martin for tanking his pay and his chance at a supervisor post.
characters.name: Derek Okafor
characters.protects: That he was docked two days' pay and demoted, and that he threatened Martin in front of witnesses.

records.summary: Payday loan of £900 outstanding, taken out the week after his demotion.
HR incident log at Pier 9 records Derek's verbal threat against Martin four weeks before the murder.
One prior: a bar brawl conviction from 2016, fine only.

characters.secret: Martin demoted him last month after a shouting match over late pay, and Derek told coworkers Martin would 'get what's coming'.

appearance.clothing: tailored blazer and bank scarf, neat bob haircut

characters.fakeMotive: Stands to collect £120,000 on Martin's life insurance policy.
characters.name: Sandra Holloway
characters.protects: Her status as life insurance beneficiary, which she does not want the police or her new partner to know about.

records.summary: Martin's life policy, £120,000, still lists Sandra Holloway as sole beneficiary; premiums paid to date.
Joint ownership of 3 Harlow Lane never fully transferred; her solicitor wrote to Martin twice this year about it.
Bank timekeeping confirms she was at her teller window continuously from 7.30am through the morning.

characters.secret: She is still a beneficiary on Martin's life insurance because he never updated the paperwork after the divorce.

appearance.clothing: oil-smeared overalls, baseball cap worn backwards
appearance.shoes: canvas trainers with a split sole

characters.fakeMotive: Martin owed him £2,500 from their grey-market parts deal and had stopped paying.
characters.name: Caleb Rusk
characters.protects: The stolen-parts racket, not the murder, since admitting it means a prison sentence.

records.summary: Text messages and a handwritten IOU recovered in a past civil dispute mention £2,500 owed by 'Holloway' to Rusk.
Suspended sentence in 2021 for handling stolen vehicle parts.
Registered a shell company, 'CR Auto Spares Ltd', quietly dissolved in 2023 after a tax probe.

characters.secret: He sold Martin stolen forklift parts two years ago, and Martin has been shorting him on their side deal ever since.

appearance.clothing: denim jacket over a café apron, chunky rings

characters.fakeMotive: A humiliating breakup and the rumour that Martin was going back to his ex-wife.
characters.name: Nadia Ferreira
characters.protects: That she still had Martin's flat key and wallet on the morning he died, which would make her look like a thief.

records.summary: Social media posts show the relationship ended publicly ten days before the murder, with mutual friends taking sides.
A neighbour logged a noise complaint during her row with Martin outside Harlow Lane last week.

characters.secret: She ended things with Martin the week before because he was still texting his ex-wife, and she kept his spare key and his wallet after an argument.

appearance.clothing: dark quilted coat with 'SECURITY' on the back

characters.fakeMotive: Martin was about to get him sacked for sleeping on duty.
characters.name: George Pelling
characters.protects: That he routinely sleeps through his nights and falsifies his patrol log, and that Martin knew.

records.summary: Pier 9 patrol logs show long gaps George cannot account for; management was flagged for review.
Council tax arrears of two years; a bailiff letter is filed against him.

characters.relationshipToVictim: Martin's night guard at the warehouse
characters.secret: Martin caught him sleeping on shift and threatened to report him; George would lose his licence and only income.

appearance.clothing: station uniform with a fleece over the shoulders, glasses on a chain

characters.name: Ruth Calder
characters.protects: Her absence from the booth at the critical moment, which could cost her the job.

records.summary: Staff rota confirms Ruth was due on the concourse booth from 7.00am; her till was idle for eleven minutes around the collapse.

characters.relationshipToVictim: no connection; found Martin collapsed on the concourse
characters.secret: She had stepped away from her booth to chat with the café vendor when Martin collapsed, which breaches station rules.

characters.name: Farid Haddad
characters.protects: His absence from post, which he covered up in his incident report.

records.summary: His incident report claims a continuous patrol, but a café loyalty-app purchase timestamps him at Ember Café at 7.14am.

characters.relationshipToVictim: no connection; first security officer on scene
characters.secret: He left the concourse unattended to buy a coffee at Ember Café across the road shortly before the collapse.

appearance.clothing: long raincoat over a patterned dress, carrying a wheeled suitcase

characters.name: Margo Ellison
characters.protects: Her hotel arrears and her fragile living situation.

records.summary: Owes the Regent Hotel six weeks of room charges; management is threatening eviction.
Was seated on bench three, in clear view of the coffee kiosk, from about 7.05am.

characters.relationshipToVictim: no connection; was waiting for a train nearby
characters.secret: She has been living in the Regent Hotel on unpaid bills and pretends to be a traveller to avoid questions.

appearance.clothing: university hoodie, backpack with a laptop sleeve

characters.name: Orian Beck
characters.protects: His truancy and whereabouts most mornings.

records.summary: University attendance system shows a pattern of missed 9am lectures on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

characters.relationshipToVictim: no connection; commuting student who bought coffee near Martin
characters.secret: He skips his morning lectures and does not want his parents to find out via police enquiries.

output.method: Elena slipped a stolen dose of fentanyl into Martin's morning coffee while he checked the departure board, and he collapsed on the concourse minutes later.

motive.details: Elena blamed Martin for her brother's death after Martin, his supervisor at the warehouse, falsified a safety report that freed him of blame for a fatal accident. She spent two years waiting for a chance to make him pay.
